lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that align with the vertical axes of the high-luminance blobs, forming primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.
